Using Paired Samples t-Test, the results showed that the mean score of 6 coping methods including active coping (t=-5.85, P<0.001), using of emotional supports(t=-4.80, P<0.001), using of instrumental support (t=-4.89, P<0.001), positive reframing(t=-3.89, P<0.001), planning(t=-4.91, P<0.001) and acceptance (t=-5.98, P<0.001) methods significantly
